_comment: Status per feature id in docs/FEATURE_MATRIX.md. Anything at or above 'Verified equivalent' must cite evidence that a command actually ran. Regenerate the matrix with scripts/gen_feature_matrix.py.

extra_features.component: django.contrib.auth.hashers as configured by authentik (PASSWORD_HASHERS default list)
web/ Lit + PatternFly apps (admin, user, flow)

contract:password-hashers.evidence: Scope: hasher library only (encode/verify/must_update/make_password/is_password_usable), not the password stage or login flow. `tests/differential/passwords/run.sh` against authentik 2026.2.7 (Django 5.2.17, argon2-cffi 25.1.0, bcrypt 5.0.0) on 2026-10-30: 152/152 encodings byte-identical, 65/65 verify_password outcomes (incl. raised exceptions) equal, 31/31 Rust-made hashes accepted by Django check_password, reference akadmin row verifies.

web:frontend.rust: unchanged; served by the Rust server from web/dist
